pipeline.note: No new generation. The 85 maps were composed again on 2026-09-25 from the saved detail passes of the 2026-09-04 minetest-game-terrain-v2-final run, which reproduces 1.0.0 byte for byte under the code that made it. 1.0.0 carried the height scaled by the class depth, which the shader applies again; every _n map now spans the whole byte (1.0.0 median span 141, 42 under 128; now 255). The height range is also taken from the texels the source draws, which moves the _n of the 17 stems with transparent texels further. Every _s map is byte identical to 1.0.0.

release.known_failures_note: Fails one rule, normal field has a strong directional bias. It failed the same rule in 1.0.0 and shipped there too.
